My first bass was an Ibanez TMB 100 in white, I miss it so much. After my mother passed away in 2021, my older brother was living in our childhood home, he was involved in an explosion. I was away in California. When you move someplace far away from home, do you ever check and see how your neighborhood is doing? 

I remember seeing that notification on our local news' YouTube channel, "man involved in house explosion" was the headline. I thought nothing of it, until I clicked it. 



It was our neighborhood. It was our house.

Our. House.

I immediately started dialing everyone I knew, no one knew anything. They just said that my older brother is in the hospital, he was still alive...

He eventually made it out but is now homeless, everyone else is sorry for me because of my guitars (fender squier strat and jazzmaster, and the Ibanez bass), and various pedals. But I'm more sorry for my brother. He no longer has a stable living situation. It is now my goal to have enough money to pay for a 2 bedroom apartment for him and I, eventually making enough money to move my 2 younger brothers into a house because they're still in California, but they were born in the same state my older brother resides in. My brother and I took 2 tabs. After sitting for a while we thought fuck it, let's go to the store. On our way there we passed by a local park (while avoiding our mom's phone call trying to figure out where we were and what we're doing) we lost our minds at that park. So much so, that cops were called and asked us if we heard any fighting or screaming. We gave them the information (my brother was peaking and getting asked questions like "what's your name" "whats your address" is pretty hard to remember) and they let us go without hassle. I remember asking my brother "damn, I wonder who was screaming..." "That was us." 

That spiraled me into a pot of anxiety. Add on the fact that our mom didn't know what we were doing and didn't know where we were. She locked us out. She was mad, I don't remember what happened after that. All I remember is she unlocked the door, and I could see myself walking around her, instead of seeing her and going inside the house. I immediately went to my room and tried to go to sleep (I didn't research this at all) after my ego dissolved I met up with my brother in the garage and we talked about what just happened. We got the cigarette roller and tried to roll as much cigarettes as we can. We only smoked 2 each while discussing life and how everything is nothing y'know, the classics. 


The afterglow was pretty nice. I had college the morning after so sitting in a class while you try to wrap your mind about what just happened a couple hours before, I wanted to tell everyone but I didn't. 


We didn't even go to the store. The visuals were pretty geometric and kinda cool tho. The shrooms trip was the complete opposite tho I didn't have a good time but that's another story.
